Visual identity study

Nailsbyenny

Let the detail set the mood.

The starting point

Let the detail set the mood.

A beauty identity often meets someone beside the work itself: a close-up of a set, a profile picture or a booking post. This study explores a setting that feels composed without taking attention away from the nails.

The work covered

  • Visual direction
  • Wordmark exploration
  • Colour palette
  • Typography and image pairing

The decisions

A reason for
the choices.

A fine script signature sits with blush, cream and a deep neutral. The restrained palette and delicate supporting type create a consistent mood around the imagery. The work shown is an identity board, rather than a full production-ready brand kit.

  • #F4E9DF
  • #BF9C95
  • #2C211A

The words

Elegant. Artistic. Timeless.

Three concise cues establish the intended mood. A practical booking message would still need the service, availability and next step beside it.
